tools.name: generate_image
tools.description: Generate an image from a text prompt with the local Qwen-Image 2.1 model. Dimensions are chosen automatically (aspect ratio can be inferred from the prompt, e.g. '16:9 hero image') unless width/height or aspect_ratio are given. Returns the absolute path of the saved PNG. Runs fully offline; typically 45 s–4 min.

prompt.description: What to generate, in natural language

width.description: Output width in pixels (needs height too). Omit to choose automatically.

height.description: Output height in pixels (needs width too).

aspect_ratio.description: Aspect ratio such as 1:1, 4:3, 3:4, 16:9, 9:16, or auto (inferred from the prompt)

quality.description: All run Qwen-Image 2.1 Turbo (8 steps): fast = ~1 MP (the default, fastest); balanced = ~1.5K; quality = native 2K (slowest; edits share 2K with their references)

seed.description: Seed for reproducible results; omit or -1 for random

output_path.description: Optional destination (absolute, or relative to the project). Must be inside the project or the app output folder. Existing files are never overwritten; a numbered name is used instead.

include_preview.description: Also return a small JPEG preview in the tool result. Default false: images stay local and are not sent to the model.

tools.name: edit_image
tools.description: Edit an existing image with a natural-language instruction (e.g. 'make the background nighttime, keep the foreground unchanged'). Preserves the input's width, height and aspect ratio by default. The input file is never overwritten.

image_path.description: Image to edit (absolute, or relative to the project)

prompt.description: The change to make, e.g. 'make the background nighttime, keep the foreground unchanged'

output_path.description: Optional destination (absolute, or relative to the project). Must be inside the project or the app output folder. Existing files are never overwritten; a numbered name is used instead.

quality.description: All run Qwen-Image 2.1 Turbo (8 steps): fast = ~1 MP (the default, fastest); balanced = ~1.5K; quality = native 2K (slowest; edits share 2K with their references)

preserve_dimensions.description: Keep the input's exact width/height (default true)

seed.description: Seed for reproducible results; omit or -1 for random

include_preview.description: Also return a small JPEG preview in the tool result. Default false: images stay local and are not sent to the model.

tools.name: edit_images
tools.description: Create an image from several reference images (up to 10) and an instruction. Order matters: refer to them as image 1, image 2, ... in the prompt. The output follows image 1's aspect ratio unless width/height or aspect_ratio are given.

image_paths.description: Reference images in order; refer to them as image 1, image 2, ... in the prompt

prompt.description: e.g. 'Use the person from image 1, the clothing from image 2 and the lighting of image 3'

aspect_ratio.description: Aspect ratio such as 1:1, 4:3, 3:4, 16:9, 9:16, or auto (inferred from the prompt)

quality.description: All run Qwen-Image 2.1 Turbo (8 steps): fast = ~1 MP (the default, fastest); balanced = ~1.5K; quality = native 2K (slowest; edits share 2K with their references)

seed.description: Seed for reproducible results; omit or -1 for random

output_path.description: Optional destination (absolute, or relative to the project). Must be inside the project or the app output folder. Existing files are never overwritten; a numbered name is used instead.

include_preview.description: Also return a small JPEG preview in the tool result. Default false: images stay local and are not sent to the model.

tools.name: outpaint_image
tools.description: Extend an image beyond its borders. Give the expansion per side in pixels or percent; the canvas, mask and model-aligned sizes are built automatically and the original pixels are preserved exactly.

prompt.description: What the extended area should contain

units.description: Units for left/right/top/bottom; percent is relative to the image width (left/right) or height (top/bottom)

seed.description: Seed for reproducible results; omit or -1 for random

quality.description: All run Qwen-Image 2.1 Turbo (8 steps): fast = ~1 MP (the default, fastest); balanced = ~1.5K; quality = native 2K (slowest; edits share 2K with their references)

output_path.description: Optional destination (absolute, or relative to the project). Must be inside the project or the app output folder. Existing files are never overwritten; a numbered name is used instead.

include_preview.description: Also return a small JPEG preview in the tool result. Default false: images stay local and are not sent to the model.

tools.name: inpaint_image
tools.description: Change only the masked area of an image (mask: white = change, black = keep): edit it, remove what is there, replace it, or add something inside it. The model is shown the area marked on a copy of the image; pixels outside the mask are preserved exactly.

mask_path.description: Mask image: white = area to change, black = keep (or opaque strokes on a transparent layer)

action.description: edit: change the area as the prompt says; remove: erase what is there and fill with background (prompt optional, e.g. 'the bin'); replace: put the prompt's subject in its place; add: add the prompt's subject inside the area

prompt.description: The change, or the subject to add/replace with; optional for remove

seed.description: Seed for reproducible results; omit or -1 for random

quality.description: All run Qwen-Image 2.1 Turbo (8 steps): fast = ~1 MP (the default, fastest); balanced = ~1.5K; quality = native 2K (slowest; edits share 2K with their references)

output_path.description: Optional destination (absolute, or relative to the project). Must be inside the project or the app output folder. Existing files are never overwritten; a numbered name is used instead.

include_preview.description: Also return a small JPEG preview in the tool result. Default false: images stay local and are not sent to the model.

tools.name: upscale_image
tools.description: Enlarge an image (default 2x, or to a width/height up to 8192 px). Runs the upscaler model chosen in Kokon (Superscale-SP by default; seconds on a PC GPU, longer on a Mac; adds no new content). Saves a new file; the input is never overwritten.

image_path.description: Image to upscale (absolute, or relative to the project)

scale.description: Enlargement factor, e.g. 2 (default 2 when no width/height is given)

width.description: Target width in pixels; height follows the aspect ratio unless also given

height.description: Target height in pixels; width follows the aspect ratio unless also given

output_path.description: Optional destination (absolute, or relative to the project). Must be inside the project or the app output folder. Existing files are never overwritten; a numbered name is used instead.

include_preview.description: Also return a small JPEG preview in the tool result. Default false: images stay local and are not sent to the model.

tools.name: get_image_info
tools.description: Width, height, aspect ratio, file type and, for images made by Kokon, the generation metadata (prompt, seed, model, steps...).

tools.name: get_generator_status
tools.description: Whether the local inference server is running and the model loaded, GPU and VRAM, the active job and the queue.
